info.description:
Generated from the project's urls.py and views (every endpoint, method, query and body field).
1. Fill baseUrl, mobile/otp (admin or staff), parentMobile/parentOtp (parent).
2. Run 'Auth & Profile > Admin verify OTP' -> saves token (backoffice APIs).
3. Run 'Parent verify OTP' -> saves parentToken, kidId, schoolId (app APIs).
4. Optional query params are included but disabled; enable what you need.
Example values are placeholders - replace with real data.
